name: Tata.ev
summary: India's flagship electric passenger 4-wheeler and commercial vehicle leader offering electric hatchbacks, SUVs, and urban cargo mini-trucks backed by nationwide service.

name: Mahindra
summary: Homegrown Indian automotive powerhouse pioneering Born Electric passenger 4W SUVs alongside India's largest electric 3-wheeler auto and cargo fleet.

name: Ather Energy
summary: Bengaluru-founded smart electric 2-wheeler pioneer renowned for the 450 performance series, Rizta family scooter, and the Ather Grid fast-charging network.

name: TVS Motor
summary: Iconic Indian manufacturer delivering refined, practical electric 2-wheelers through the TVS iQube lineup and expanding into electric 3-wheelers.

name: Bajaj Chetak
summary: Blends solid-steel Indian heritage with modern electric drivetrains across the Bajaj Chetak 2-wheeler scooter range and GoGo electric 3-wheelers.

name: Ola Electric
summary: High-scale Indian EV manufacturer building S1 electric scooters and Roadster electric motorcycles with MoveOS software at its Futurefactory.

name: Hero Lectro
summary: The electric cycle division of Hero Cycles—India's largest e-cycle manufacturer offering city commuter, MTB, and cargo pedal-assist electric bicycles.

name: EMotorad
summary: Pune-headquartered Indian electric cycle innovator building smart commuter, folding fat-tyre, and adventure e-cycles exported globally.

name: Hero VIDA
summary: Powered by Hero MotoCorp, VIDA offers Indian electric 2-wheeler scooters with removable dual-battery convenience and wide fast-charging access.

name: Ultraviolette
summary: Indigenous aerospace-inspired performance 2-wheeler EV maker engineering the flagship F77 Mach 2 electric sportbike and high-density SRB battery systems.

name: Revolt Motors
summary: One of India's earliest commuter electric motorcycle brands delivering everyday 2-wheeler street bikes with portable home-chargeable lithium-ion packs.

name: Oben Electric
summary: Homegrown R&D-driven EV motorcycle company designing the Rorr street bike around high-heat-tolerant LFP battery packs built for Indian traffic.

name: River Mobility
summary: Indian electric 2-wheeler company behind the River Indie—known as the 'SUV of scooters' for its 14-inch wheels, crash guards, and 43L underseat storage.

name: Ampere (Greaves)
summary: Backed by Greaves Cotton, Ampere builds family electric 2-wheelers (Nexus, Magnus) alongside Greaves 3-wheeler electric passenger and cargo vehicles.

name: Simple Energy
summary: Indian clean-mobility company engineering high-range connected electric 2-wheeler scooters with in-house motor and dual-battery pack designs.

name: Kinetic Green
summary: Indian EV maker offering the utility-focused Kinetic E-Luna moped alongside Safar electric passenger e-rickshaws and 3-wheeler cargo loaders.

name: Matter
summary: Gujarat-headquartered EV technology innovator creator of the Matter Aera—India's liquid-cooled 4-speed hyper-shift geared electric motorcycle.

name: Tork Motors
summary: Pune-born electric 2-wheeler company developing axial-flux motor drivetrains and the Kratos R urban electric streetfighter.

name: Euler Motors
summary: Indian EV specialist building liquid-cooled heavy-payload 3-wheeler cargo loaders (HiLoad EV) and compact 4-wheel commercial trucks (Storm EV).

name: Altigreen
summary: Indigenous EV manufacturer designing high-volumetric neEV electric 3-wheeler cargo loaders purpose-built for Indian urban delivery fleets.

name: Omega Seiki Mobility
summary: Indian clean-logistics OEM producing the Rage+ electric 3-wheeler series and urban electric commercial trucks for e-commerce and cold-chain fleets.

name: Switch Mobility
summary: The electric commercial vehicle arm of Hinduja Group's Ashok Leyland, manufacturing IeV4 electric LCV pickups and EiV electric city buses in India.

name: Olectra Greentech
summary: Hyderabad-headquartered commercial EV leader operating thousands of electric city buses, intercity coaches, and heavy electric tippers across India.

name: JBM Electric Vehicles
summary: Indian commercial electric bus and charging infrastructure manufacturer producing zero-emission Ecolife city, airport tarmac, and luxury coach EVs.

name: JSW MG Motor
summary: Indo-global joint venture (JSW MG Motor India) offering connected electric 4-wheeler crossovers and city EVs including the Windsor EV, ZS EV, and Comet EV.

name: BYD India
summary: Global new-energy vehicle manufacturer retailing Blade LFP battery electric 4-wheeler SUVs and MPVs in India.

name: Piaggio Vehicles
summary: Three-wheeler specialist producing the Apé Electrik range of passenger e-autos and cargo 3-wheelers at its Baramati plant in Maharashtra.
